verified_observations: Luxury real estate agency in central Yerevan; specializes in sale, purchase, and rental of high-end properties (apartments, private houses, land, business centers, hotels, restaurants) in Yerevan center including Northern Avenue, Cascade, Opera areas.
20 Years of Expertise claimed; contact phone +374 91 57 47 57 listed on official site.
Website offers property search with filters (type, region, city, district, rooms, price, area, renovation, currency) and social links to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube.
weaknesses: No clear dedicated contact page with address/map or detailed agent contact info visible on homepage.
Search UI appears dense/cramped with many filter fields stacked; mobile experience not evident.
No client portal or saved-search/user-account features visible.
